Could rain have caused this?: We couldn't check the rainfall for this place, so we can't say yet.
How sure can we be?: Fairly sure. The change shows up in more than one later image.
What could be wrong?: These are estimates. Very wet fields can sometimes look like water. Some spots, like steep hillsides, can't be seen clearly and are left out. Some of the satellite images are early versions, so the numbers may change a little later.
Did the water go down anywhere?: No, not in any noticeable way. The water only spread between these dates.
